install.title: 📦 Mod Installation
install.forge_neoforge.title: With Forge or NeoForge
install.forge_neoforge.step1: Download Forge or NeoForge
install.forge_neoforge.step2: Run the installer and select Install Client
install.forge_neoforge.step3: Open the Minecraft launcher and select the Forge or NeoForge profile
install.forge_neoforge.step4: Place your .jar files in the mods/ folder
install.fabric.title: With Fabric
install.fabric.step4: Place your mods in the mods/ folder
install.fabric.warning: ⚠️ Compatibility: Forge, NeoForge and Fabric mods are not compatible with each other. Always check the required mod loader.
install.app.title: Using an app (CurseForge, Modrinth, etc.)
install.app.intro: If you are using an app like CurseForge App, Modrinth App, Prism Launcher or similar:
install.app.step1: Open the app and go to the Mods section
install.app.step2: Use the search bar to find the mod you want
install.app.step3: Make sure the Minecraft version and mod loader match your profile
install.app.warning: ⚠️ Mod missing or update not showing? If no results match your search, the mod or update may not be available yet (app sync delay) for your Minecraft version or mod loader. Try changing the version in the search filters, or check the mod page directly on CurseForge / Modrinth to verify supported versions.

sirens.desc: Phax Sirens adds alarm siren blocks to Minecraft. Each siren is fully configurable and produces sound and light effects to secure your bases or create immersive atmospheres.

potion.desc: Phax: Potion Time+ takes all existing potions in Minecraft and adds extended duration versions: 15 minutes, 30 minutes and 1 hour. Perfect for long exploration or combat sessions!

potion.feat2: All vanilla potions in 30 min version
potion.feat3: All vanilla potions in 1 hour version
